name_en: Yamanashi shoyu no mi — the koji-fermented soybean solids left from making soy sauce
summary_ja: 煮た大豆に麦麹を混ぜてわらに包み、数日発酵させる芦安地域の保存食。各家庭で醤油をつくった名残の副産物とされ、貴重なたんぱく源として麦ごはんにのせて食べてきたと伝わる。
summary_en: Boiled soybeans are mixed with barley koji, wrapped in straw, and left to ferment for several days — a keeping food from the Ashiyasu area, said to be a byproduct of home soy-sauce-making once common there, eaten over barley rice as a valued source of protein.
source_title: しょうゆの実 山梨県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省
